Name: Cheaper Beach Bridge Repair
Author: Annosz
Description:
[code][/code][code][/code][size=5]Cheaper Beach Bridge Repair[/size]

Isn't it strange that those two planks cost 300 pieces of wood to repair - the same as building as a whole coop?

This mod makes it more realistic by changing the wood requirement to only 8 pieces, making it possible to harvest the riches of the tidal ponds much earlier in the game.



[size=4]Requirements[/size]

This mod requires SMAPI.



[size=4]Configuration[/size]

In the config.json you can change:
[list]
[*]The price of repairing the bridge
[/list]


﻿[size=4]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][list=1][code][/code][/list]
